disqualifier.note: hideIndicator is the caller chrome flag; nestLabel is the independently derived single-item layout bit from items.length===1 && indicator!==dot. The helper returns an icon, null, or the mark on separate arms and never masks a combined-true case. All four supplied pairs are supported.

Pass-through props on the default tooltip row: hideIndicator is forwarded to ChartTooltipIndicator while nestLabel independently switches items-end vs items-center and label nesting. Combined true is a supported layout, not an illegal tuple.

Row props receive hideIndicator from ChartTooltipContent and nestLabel from payload-length/indicator. They are forwarded together but remain independent axes; formatter vs default-item branches do not treat both-true as a masked union.
